brands.name: Pipedream Surfboards
brands.short_description: Currumbin Waters, Queensland surfboards shaped by Murray Bourton since 1974.

models.name: Twin Carby Twin Fin
models.description: The Twin Carby is a performance twin fin with area forward, a straighter plan in the back half, a small release flyer, and an aggressively deep pulled-in swallow. Low entry rocker with minimal tail flip; the bottom rolls in the nose, then moves through moderate concave into an aggressive vee.

models.name: PERFORMANCE TWIN FIN
models.description: The Performance Twinny is a small, high-performance twin fin meant to be ridden short and pushed hard. Extra nose width for paddle and control, a straighter outline from centre to tail, and a small fluted flyer into a pulled-in swallow.

models.name: TRI FIN TOW BOARD
models.description: A narrow, thin tow-in gun with a biting swallow tail and deep 10mm concave from nose to tail. Built for high-speed control in large waves, with the rider positioned forward in straps.
